title: The event loop is not a queue, it is a lap
body: Each iteration runs a fixed sequence of phases: timers, pending callbacks, poll, check, close. Between every callback Node drains the microtask queue, and process.nextTick jumps ahead of even that.

title: require() caches modules
body: A CommonJS module body runs once. Every later require() of the same resolved path returns the same module.exports object, which is why a module can hold shared state.

title: Stream files, don't read them
body: fs.readFile buffers the whole file in memory before you can send a byte. fs.createReadStream piped to the response keeps memory flat regardless of file size.

title: Blocking the loop blocks everyone
body: There is one thread running your JavaScript. A synchronous 200ms loop adds 200ms to every request already in flight. Push CPU-heavy work to worker_threads or a child process.
